scheme_name: Scholarship Scheme for Worker's Children- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Worker must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Monthly salary of the worker must not exceed ₹25,000
Service period of the worker is fixed for one year
Children studying in 9th grade or above are eligible
Benefits limited to three girls and two boys per worker
Application must be submitted on or before 31 December
Children already receiving scholarships from other institutions are also eligible
Children who dropped out and later resumed studies are eligible
Children studying outside Haryana are eligible
False certification may lead to future disqualification and repayment of the received amount
benefits_summary: Provides annual scholarships ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹21,000 depending on the student’s class or degree.
